limitations: Human no-AI use and tools are self-attested, not independently observed.
Prior AI-assisted health exercise excluded; followup includes learning effect.
Duplicate grid attempt retained separately, not counted as a fourth category or substituted for first run.
Agent is first-party sponsored deterministic analysis, not paid independent provider delivery or proof of LLM reasoning advantage.
Agent HTTP timing excludes shared source collection and setup; human timer includes reading, calculation and writing. Ratios are not end-to-end productivity proof.
All direct fees recorded as zero; this excludes subscription costs, equipment, platform hosting and participant labor.
No independent reviewer, no blinded scores, no official acceptance or prize eligibility proof.
Original answers retained unchanged, including omissions.

quality_assessment.method: Entrant AI-assisted formula and completeness check; not independent human scoring.
quality_assessment.numeric_findings: Reported grid levels, yield calculations and health-factor/repayment figures agree with the supplied formulas at displayed precision.

manual_omissions.grid: Execution prerequisites and whether drawdown is enforced are missing.
manual_omissions.yield: Explicit ranking conclusion and changing-rate/cost/return limitations are missing.

quality_assessment.agent_limitations: Risk labels are not full explanations. TVL zero is an unknown-input placeholder. All outputs are deterministic previews without execution authority.

comparison_claim: Descriptive records only. No end-to-end speedup, superiority, profit or eligibility claim.
privacy: Operator names removed from public copies; exact original exports retained privately.

provenance_review.reason: A contemporaneous user ChatGPT conversation contained worked answers to these task prompts. This is not proof that each saved answer used AI, but self-attestation alone cannot resolve the inconsistency. Match original run timestamps and assistance before treating any affected run as an unassisted control.
